headline: Warden Works Vanish in Weathered Expanse; Mooring County Swept Clean
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has been swept nearly bare. Six of its nine works now stand unclaimed where three did at the last filing, and the Wardens are reduced to a single hold against two Colonial; the sector logged eighty-one events in the day and fourteen in the last two hours, on a ledger of 8,375 Colonial and 11,475 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours, with fresh reports arriving at the hour of this dispatch. Mooring County runs the other way, reading twelve Warden works and none Colonial, two retaken since the morning, with forty-two events and 7,246 against 6,299 casualties on the day. Nevish Line holds at six Warden and two Colonial; twenty-four events were counted there, though the past two hours passed in silence. Callahan's Passage remains under fire, its casualties running 253 Colonial and 247 Warden in the latest hour. Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row, which churned hard yesterday, have gone quiet some seventeen hours. Across 436 works the Colonials hold 304, the Wardens 124, and eight lie unclaimed; thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
